warnings: Dimensions come from the printed drawing. Body length is 28.5 mm, body width is 15.5 mm, and the 4 mm hole center is 35.45 mm from the body's far end. The scale is about 8 px/mm. The spacer extends about 4.9 mm beyond the hole center, so I estimated overall length as 35.45 + 4.9 ≈ 40.3 mm. The 5.6 mm label appears to be the spacer height. The body sits slightly above the spacer, so I estimated total thickness at about 6.6 mm. That value and the hole's z position are scaled from the drawing, not printed. The hole looks open in the views, so I recorded it as through. The 150 mm wire leads and the connectors (XT30, 3.5 mm bullets, servo-style signal header) are excluded from the bounds. The box is centered on the part at the origin.
Body thickness (about 4.5 mm), z offsets, spacer diameter (about 9.7 mm) and tab thickness are estimated from the drawing.
Wires, connectors (XT30, bullet, TJC8), the LED and the logo are omitted.
The analysis lists the hole at y=0, but it is placed at the body mid-width (y=7.75) because the bottom of the part sits at Y=0.
Edges are sharp; the heat-shrink taper at the body ends is not modeled.
